notes: Both genitive-displaced articles (s014, s019) are left unrepresented under rule 20, the possessives belonging to ὧν and αὐτῶν.
αὐτῷ τῷ καιρῷ split as article → *that*, intensive → *very*, noun → *season*, following rule 60's αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ → *that very hour*.
Παρῆσαν takes the whole existential frame *there were … present* discontinuously under rule 15, headed on the lexical predicate under rule 17.
